author: Verity I
title: Triad motif from grid (tightest pair + nearest third; LP-gated; grid fallback)
abstract: Deterministic triad move from a 6×6−corners grid: orthogonal split on the tightest pair plus an outward stabilizer on the nearest third circle. Solve radii via exact LP (HiGHS). Accept only if Δ∑r>1e−8 and all post–1e−12-shrink slacks ≥1e−10; else return the grid LP result with a 1e−12 micro‑shrink. No writes in the return path.
